messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads up — were moving the Recognition nomination form off Google Forms and into the new Airtable base this week. Goal: better tagging, reporting, and one-click export for payroll. Need quick sign-off on the taxonomy and required fields by EOD Wednesday.
Jordan (People Ops): Nice — can you post the proposed fields/tags here?
Priya (People Ops): Yep. Proposed fields: nominator_name, nominee_name, org, team, category_tag (Culture / Customer Impact / Technical / Leadership / Above & Beyond), impact_scale (1-5), short_reason (max 300 chars), manager_verify (yes/no), budget_code (optional), anonymous_flag (yes/no). Also add an internal-only note field for ops.
Sam (Eng): For category_tag, can we allow multiple tags? sometimes things are both technical + customer impact.
Priya (People Ops): Good point — will allow up to 2 tags. I'll note that in the form UX.
Lina (Design): Quick UX ask: if anonymous_flag = yes, hide nominee contact fields and show a required manager_verify step. Otherwise we'll get payroll mismatches.
Priya (People Ops): Agreed. Plan is anonymous nominations still require a manager_confirm checkbox and manager_email to verify identity for reward distribution.
Kelly (Finance): On budget_code: we'll need a dropdown mapping to GL codes. Can ops provide a default code and a free-text override for cross-org gifts? Also need to confirm tax handling for >$600 amounts.
Priya (People Ops): Default code will be RECOG-EXP-01; managers can provide override if finance approves. For tax, we follow the existing policy — Finance to flag any single award >$600 for 1099/ payroll reporting.
Kelly (Finance): OK I'll send over the GL list before EOD.
Jordan (People Ops): Migration checklist draft: 1) build Airtable base + form 2) import last 12 months of nominations (CSV) 3) QA by people-ops + finance 4) small pilot with 3 teams 5) flip DNS/form redirect + announce.
Priya (People Ops): Exactly. CSV header mapping I used for import: ```nominator_name,nominee_name,org,team,category_tag,impact_scale,short_reason,manager_verify,budget_code,anonymous_flag,internal_note```
Sam (Eng): Who wants to run the pilot? I can test with Platform team on Thurs morning.
Lina (Design): I'll test on PMs and Design Wed afternoon.
Jordan (People Ops): I'll coordinate a Friday pilot with Sales ops. Can we have a shared test link?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — Ill post the Airtable form link here once the base is live. Also want to iterate on copy for the nomination confirmation email. Draft below: "Thank you for your nomination for {nominee_name}. Your nomination will be reviewed and manager verification is required before rewards are processed." Thoughts?
Kelly (Finance): Add a line: "If award value exceeds $600 USD the company will follow applicable tax reporting requirements."
Priya (People Ops): Good call — added.
Jordan (People Ops): Small ask — can we add a hidden field for source_campaign (used when ops seeds + programmatic nominations happen)?
Priya (People Ops): Added as hidden metadata in Airtable.
Sam (Eng): One more: can we surface a simple report in Airtable view that groups by category_tag and org for monthly review?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — I'll create views: Pending Manager Verify, Ready for Payout, By Category (monthly), By Org (monthly).
Lina (Design): Also please include the short_reason char limit hint and a microcopy on what impact_scale 1-5 represents.
Priya (People Ops): Will do.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: will post to #general once migration goes live (2pm PT Thurs) :bell:
Jordan (People Ops): Who's owner for post-migration monitoring? we should watch for duplicates and missing manager_verify flags for first 48h.
Priya (People Ops): Jordan and I will own monitoring; Kelly will spot-check finance mappings. Please ping here if you see anything odd during pilots.
Sam (Eng): Sounds good — I'll try to break it during the Platform pilot :hammer_and_wrench: 
Priya (People Ops): Thanks y'all. I'll share the Airtable link and the final field list in this thread when ready.
